verdict.rationale: Composio documents a first-party "provider" adapter layer that converts its tools into each framework's native tool format, and claims it "works with any AI framework." However, the evidence never names which frameworks have providers, so coverage of the specific ones in the story is unproven. missing for 10: explicit evidence of adapters for Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI SDK and Anthropic SDK, per-framework setup docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of adapter use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug the platform's tools into major agent frameworks and SDKs (Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs) with documented adapters

citations.quote: Composio works with any AI framework. A provider is the adapter that turns Composio tools into the native tool format your framework expects, so you don't write glue code.
